objective: Keep the weft coverage diagnosis intact when check-coverage runs under turbo with stderr piped.
constraints: Keep the signal handler explicit exit unchanged.
Prove the fix with a child Bun process whose stderr is a pipe, not with a mock.
Change no threshold, allowance, timeout, or retry.
completedWork: Traced the truncated output to process.exit() discarding unflushed process.stderr writes.
Observed that a console.error issued behind a large queued stderr write can be dropped or interleaved.
validatedFacts: Each failing run under turbo showed only about 74KB of the child's output tail, cut mid-line at the same text.
Two direct runs of check-coverage.ts at the same revision, writing to a file instead of a pipe, both exited 0.
COR-1326 prints a stage reason on every failing exit, but its observed-working case had a tail small enough to fit in the pipe.

unresolvedQuestions: Why does the coverage shard exit 1 intermittently? This defect has hidden the reason every time.
